decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1756_EX_001 (Site Location Plan), 1756_EX_100 (Ground Floor, First Floor and Roof Plans as existing), 1756_EX_200 (Street Elevation as Existing),  1756_EX_200 (Site Location Block Plan),  1756_EX_300, 1756_PA_100, 1756_PA_200,1756_PA_300 and a Design and Access Statement (Ref: 1756)   Received: 22 November 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The extension hereby approved shall be used solely as part of the house known as 32 Tawny Close, Feltham TW13 7LH and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes and the premises shall not be used as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) (England) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no further extension(s) or additional structures/buildings shall be erected within the curtilage of the site.

Condition : 6 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south-eastern wall of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to replace existing garage, a single storey rear extension and extension to existing porch
